design.revision: round 6: fan plan with ramped main phases (common onset after a 10 s approach at the crawl rate; the planned deceleration of every unit rises over 35 % of its main duration to its peak, holds it and falls back over the last 35 %, as a symmetric staircase on the planning grid of 250 ms; joins onto a common crawl, 5 s tail crawl, synchronized braking at a_b from T_xi); head peak rate 0.45 m/s^2; handoff box (0.05 m, 0.005 m/s); lambda re-selected
design.reference: head: a_r = a*_1 of certify_plan.plan(cfg) on [0, T_xi), -a_b until v_r = 0; followers: rho_i = a*_i - a*_{i-1} in local time from the closure onset (sim_hr.hr_setup)

columns.disp: stopping-time dispersion, last stop minus first stop [s] (None: not every unit stopped, or contact)
columns.gmin: smallest clearance margin g_i = c_i - s_m over the run and the pairs [m] (intersample minimum)
columns.u_abs_max: largest |applied net command| before the latch [m/s^2] (override braking included)
columns.atU: time with the applied command at the traction limit U, worst unit [s]
columns.nonneg: time with the applied command at 0 or above, worst unit [s] (includes the startup of follower i, (i-1) x 19 ms with a zero received command)
columns.nom_above_U: time with u_nom > U, worst unit [s]
columns.clipU: time in which the input set clipped the filter output at U, worst unit [s]
columns.barrier: time in which the filter lowered the applied command (fallback included), worst unit [s]
columns.fallback: time with u_cbf < -U_i^- (fallback -U_i^-), summed over the followers [s]
columns.stop_order: units in the order of their stops
columns.met: every unit stopped, no contact, dispersion <= 1 s, markers <= 3 m, gaps <= 1 m
